hindi: “शम, सन्धि, समाधान” — एक अर्थ।
english: “Peace, treaty, settlement” — [this is] one meaning.
notes: Three terms declared synonyms. sandhi = treaty (as in the 7.7 and 12.1 lines of the glossary); the 7.3/7.4 lines give bare sandhi = peace, but here śama is already 'peace', so 'treaty' keeps the three words apart. samādhi: 'settlement' (literally 'putting together'), medium confidence; Hindi uses समाधान because समाधि reads as trance. The iti is carried by the quotation marks.

hindi: राजाओं का विश्वास को प्राप्त होना — “शम, सन्धि, समाधान”।
english: The kings’ coming to trust — “peace, treaty, settlement.”
notes: Definition: the verb is not stated, so the line is rendered as a dash. upagama = approach, reaching; whose trust is not said (mutual trust of kings is the natural sense). The iti is carried by the quotation marks.

hindi: “सत्य या शपथ अस्थिर सन्धि है; प्रतिभू या प्रतिग्रह स्थिर है,” ऐसा आचार्य कहते हैं।
english: “Truth or an oath [is] an unstable treaty; a surety or a pratigraha [is] a stable [one],” say the teachers.
notes: calaḥ literally 'moving'. pratigraha is left untranslated; unit 11 defines it as the taking of relatives and chiefs (hostage-taking). The teachers' view is rejected in unit 4.

hindi: “नहीं,” ऐसा कौटिल्य कहते हैं।
english: “No,” says Kautilya.
notes: Formula of the glossary (12.1). Answers the teachers' view of unit 3.

hindi: सत्य या शपथ परलोक में और यहाँ स्थिर सन्धि है; प्रतिभू या प्रतिग्रह यहाँ के प्रयोजन वाला ही, बल की अपेक्षा रखने वाला है।
english: Truth or an oath [is] a stable treaty hereafter and here; a surety or a pratigraha, having only here as its purpose, [is] dependent on force.
notes: paratra: literally 'in the other place'; 'hereafter / next world' is the usual sense (medium). iha-artha eva: eva belongs to the compound ('here alone as purpose'). bala: 'force' here; glossary 8.5 has bala = army, which would give 'dependent on an army' (alternative).

hindi: “हम संहित हैं,” सत्य-सन्ध पहले के राजाओं ने सत्य से सन्धि की।
english: “We are allied,” the former kings, true in agreement, concluded treaties by truth.
notes: The iti closes the quoted words and is carried by the quotation marks. satya-sandha = 'whose agreement is truth' (true to his word). sandadhire: 'joined, concluded a treaty', medium.

words.gloss: fire, water, furrow, rampart, clod, elephant’s shoulder, horse’s back, chariot-seat
weapon, gem, seed, perfume, taste, gold, money

hindi: उसका अतिक्रमण होने पर शपथ से अग्नि, जल, हल की रेखा, प्राकार, ढेला, हाथी का कन्धा, घोड़े की पीठ, रथ का आसन, शस्त्र, रत्न, बीज, गन्ध, रस, सोना और धन को छुआ — “जो शपथ का अतिक्रमण करे, उसे ये मारें और छोड़ दें।”
english: In transgression of that, [they] touched with an oath fire, water, furrow, rampart, clod, elephant’s shoulder, horse’s back, chariot-seat, weapon, gem, seed, perfume, taste, gold and money: “May these slay, and abandon, him who would transgress the oath.”

text_flags.why: possible: the '-' is the e-text's line-end continuation mark left in the middle of one line, with a stray space; the compound runs on

notes: The two compounds are one long dvandva interrupted by a line-end mark ('upastha.-'), so the members are taken together; whether hasti-skandha, aśva-pṛṣṭa, ratha-upastha are single items or pairs is not marked by the dots. sītā = furrow (literal); upastha = 'lap, seat', rendered 'chariot-seat' (medium); rasa = taste (alternatives juice, poison); suvarṇa = gold and hiraṇya = money (glossary 4.1, 5.2). ālebhire: ā-√labh 'take hold of, touch'. The subject 'they' (the former kings of unit 6) is bracketed. The iti closes the quoted curse.

hindi: शपथ का अतिक्रमण होने पर महानों, तपस्वियों या मुख्यों का प्रातिभाव्य-बन्ध प्रतिभू है।
english: In transgression of the oath, the binding of suretyship of the great, of ascetics or of chiefs [is] the surety.
notes: Defines pratibhū: the suretyship-binding undertaken by the great, ascetics or chiefs, which takes effect if the oath is broken. mahatām is taken as 'of the great' (persons); bandha kept literal 'binding' (glossary 3.x leaves bandha untranslated in other contexts).

hindi: उसमें जो दूसरे को रोकने में समर्थ प्रतिभुओं को लेता है, वह छल लेता है।
english: In that, he who takes sureties capable of restraining the other, he outwits.
notes: para = the other (party), singular; not rendered 'enemy' (glossary 9.2). avagraha = restraint. No object of atisandhatte is stated.

hindi: विपरीत छल लिया जाता है।
english: The opposite is outwitted.
notes: viparīta = the one who does the opposite (here: takes sureties not capable of restraint); no noun is stated.

hindi: बन्धुओं और मुख्यों का लेना प्रतिग्रह है।
english: The taking of relatives and chiefs [is] pratigraha.
notes: Defines pratigraha. pragraha here 'taking, holding' (not the 'favouring' of glossary 8.3). bandhu-mukhya taken as dvandva 'relatives and chiefs'; alternative 'chief relatives'.

hindi: उसमें जो दूष्य अमात्य या दूष्य सन्तान को देता है, वह छल लेता है।
english: In that, he who gives a treasonable minister or a treasonable offspring, he outwits.
notes: dūṣya = the treasonable (glossary 6.2). 'In that' = in the pratigraha.

hindi: विपरीत छल लिया जाता है।
english: The opposite is outwitted.
notes: As unit 10.

words.gloss: of one trusting in the taking of a pratigraha

hindi: क्योंकि प्रतिग्रह के लेने पर विश्वास करने वाले के छिद्रों पर दूसरा निरपेक्ष प्रहार करता है।
english: For the other, regardless, strikes at the weak points of one who trusts in the taking of a pratigraha.
notes: chidra = weak point (glossary 13.4). nirapekṣa = 'without regard, unconcerned' (not caring for the pledge).

words.gloss: in the giving of a daughter and a son

hindi: किन्तु सन्तान-समाधान में, कन्या और पुत्र के दान में, कन्या देने वाला परन्तु छल लेता है।
english: But in an offspring-settlement, in the giving of a daughter and a son, [one] giving a daughter, however, outwits.
notes: apatya-samādhi: a settlement in which offspring are given (literally 'offspring-settlement'); samādhi as in unit 1. kanyā = girl, 'daughter' in running English (glossary 3.5). The two tu are rendered 'but' and 'however'. The dvandva kanyā-putra could also mean 'daughter or son'.

words.gloss: editors’ mark of doubt (not a word)

hindi: क्योंकि कन्या उत्तराधिकारी नहीं है, दूसरों के ही प्रयोजन के लिए है, और आक्लेश्या (?)।
english: For a daughter [is] a non-heir, [is] for the purpose of others only, and ākleśyā (?).

text_flags.why: possible: the editors themselves doubt the word; 'a-kleśyā' (not to be troubled) is an alternative reading, but the printed form may be original

notes: ākleśyā is marked '(?)' by the editors and is left untranslated. If read a-kleśyā it would mean 'not to be troubled'; as printed (ā-√kliś gerundive) it would mean 'to be troubled', which gives the opposite sense, so no meaning is fixed. 'eva' attaches to pareṣām ('of others alone').

hindi: पुत्र विपरीत है।
english: The son [is] the opposite.
notes: Contrasts with the daughter of unit 16 (the text itself says only 'opposite').

hindi: दो पुत्रों में भी जो कुलीन, प्राज्ञ, शूर, अस्त्र-प्रशिक्षित या एक-पुत्र को देता है, वह छल लिया जाता है।
english: Even among two sons, he who gives the high-born, the wise, the brave, the one trained in arms, or an only son, he is outwitted.
notes: putrayoḥ api: 'even of/among two sons' (case doubtful). eka-putra: here the son who is an only son (see unit 31); in unit 27 the same word describes the man with one son.

hindi: विपरीत छल लेता है।
english: The opposite outwits.
notes: As unit 10, active.

words.gloss: because of the lost line of heirs
from loss of the power of counsel
from loss of the power of energy
than the one trained in arms
from loss of the excellence of what is to be struck

hindi: क्योंकि कुलीन से अकुलीन बन्धक रखने के लिए श्रेयस्कर है, दायाद-सन्तान के लुप्त होने से; प्राज्ञ से अप्राज्ञ, मन्त्रशक्ति के लोप से; शूर से अशूर, उत्साहशक्ति के लोप से; अस्त्र-प्रशिक्षित से अस्त्र-अप्रशिक्षित, प्रहार किए जाने योग्य की सम्पत् के लोप से; एक-पुत्र से अनेक-पुत्र, निरपेक्षता से।
english: For one of low birth is better to pledge than one of high birth, because of the lost line of heirs; [one] not wise [better] than a wise one, from the loss of the power of counsel; [one] not brave [better] than a brave one, from the loss of the power of energy; [one] untrained in arms [better] than one trained in arms, from the loss of the excellence of what is to be struck; [one] not an only son [better] than an only son, because of indifference.
notes: ādhātum: 'to pledge' (glossary 3.12 ādhāna = pledging); the one who is given over. lupta-dāyāda-santāna-tva: abstract noun 'state of having the line of heirs lost'. prahartavya-sampad: gerundive 'to be struck'; probably 'capacity to strike' (alternative), kept literal, medium-low. aneka-putra literally 'having many sons' (as in unit 27); here taken as the opposite of eka-putra. śreyān is not repeated in the later clauses; supplied in brackets (English). Wherever the list uses 'than', an ablative.

words.gloss: of the high-born and the wise

hindi: कुलीन और प्राज्ञ में, कुलीन अप्राज्ञ का ऐश्वर्य-प्रकृति अनुसरण करती है; प्राज्ञ अकुलीन का मन्त्र-अधिकार अनुसरण करता है।
english: Between the high-born and the wise, the nature of lordship follows the high-born who is not wise; the authority of counsel [follows] the wise who is not high-born.
notes: aiśvarya-prakṛti = nature (svabhāva) of lordship, glossary 8.2. anuvartate, 'follows, goes with'; the sense (the lordly nature / the right to counsel attaches to each) is medium. anuvartate is not repeated in the second clause.

hindi: मन्त्र-अधिकार में भी वृद्धों के सम्पर्क से कुलीन प्राज्ञ को छल लेता है।
english: Even in the authority of counsel, the high-born outwits the wise through connection with elders.
notes: vṛddha = elders (persons), not the 'grown' of glossary 7.4; samyoga = connection (glossary 4.7).

words.gloss: of the wise and the brave

hindi: प्राज्ञ और शूर में, मति और कर्मों का योग प्राज्ञ अशूर का अनुसरण करता है; विक्रम-अधिकार शूर अप्राज्ञ का अनुसरण करता है।
english: Between the wise and the brave, the joining of thought and actions follows the wise who is not brave; the authority of valour [follows] the brave who is not wise.
notes: yoga = joining, application (not the 'acquisition' of 6.2); mati-karmaṇām taken as a dvandva 'of thought and actions' (medium). karma = action. anuvartate not repeated in the second clause.

hindi: विक्रम-अधिकार में भी हाथी को शिकारी की तरह प्राज्ञ शूर को छल लेता है।
english: Even in the authority of valour, the wise outwits the brave, like a hunter [outwitting] an elephant.

text_flags.why: possible stray final ś (likely the first letter of the next unit, which begins with śūra-)

notes: The final ś of the printed atisandhatteś looks like a stray letter (perhaps the start of the next unit's śūra...).

words.gloss: of the brave and the one trained in arms

hindi: शूर और अस्त्र-प्रशिक्षित में, विक्रम का निश्चय शूर अस्त्र-अप्रशिक्षित का अनुसरण करता है; लक्ष्य-लाभ का अधिकार अस्त्र-प्रशिक्षित अशूर का अनुसरण करता है।
english: Between the brave and the one trained in arms, the resolve of valour follows the brave one untrained in arms; the authority of acquiring the target [follows] the one trained in arms who is not brave.
notes: vyavasāya = resolve, determination (Hindi निश्चय, not व्यवसाय). lambha = acquisition (glossary 13.5); lakṣya = target, mark.

words.gloss: in the authority of acquiring the target

hindi: लक्ष्य-लाभ के अधिकार में भी स्थिरता, समझ और हानि के अभाव से शूर अस्त्र-प्रशिक्षित को छल लेता है।
english: Even in the authority of acquiring the target, the brave outwits the one trained in arms through steadiness, understanding and non-loss.
notes: pratipatti = understanding, readiness (medium); asammoṣa literally 'non-stealing / non-loss', possibly 'freedom from confusion' (alternative); low-medium.

words.gloss: of the one with many sons and the one with one son

hindi: बहुत पुत्रों वाले और एक पुत्र वाले में, बहुत पुत्रों वाला एक को देकर, शेष से सहारा पाया हुआ सन्धि का अतिक्रमण करता है, दूसरा नहीं।
english: Of the one with many sons and the one with one son, the one with many sons, having given one, supported by the rest, transgresses the treaty; not the other.
notes: pratiṣṭabdha (prati-√stambh): 'propped, supported'; alternative 'made firm, obstinate'. 'ekam' = one (son), no noun stated.

words.gloss: in the giving of a son and all one’s property

hindi: यदि पुत्र और सर्वस्व के दान में सन्धि है, पुत्र-फल से विशेष है।
english: If the treaty [is] in the giving of a son and all one’s property, [there is] a distinction from the fruit of sons.
notes: sarva-sva = one's entire property. Whether 'son' and 'all property' are two alternatives ('or') is not clear; rendered by the dvandva 'and'. putra-phala 'fruit of sons' is literal; the sense (benefit expected from the son) is medium-low.

hindi: दो समान फल वालों में, समर्थ प्रजनन से विशेष है।
english: Between two of equal fruit, [there is] a distinction from capable procreation.
notes: Continues unit 28. prajanana = procreation, begetting.

hindi: समर्थ प्रजनन वाले दो में भी उपस्थित प्रजनन से विशेष है।
english: Even between two of capable procreation, [there is] a distinction from procreation at hand.
notes: upasthita = present, at hand, ready; the exact sense (offspring already present) is not fixed.

words.gloss: one whose birth of sons is lost

hindi: किन्तु शक्तिमान् एक-पुत्र में, लुप्त पुत्र-उत्पत्ति वाला अपने को बन्धक रखे, और एक-पुत्र को नहीं।
english: But in the case of a capable only son, [one] whose birth of sons is lost should pledge himself, and not an only son.
notes: The closing iti has no opening quotation in the unit; it is not rendered (it probably closes the whole discussion of units 28-31). ca-eka-putram: 'and not an only son'. lupta-putra-utpatti: one who can no longer beget sons.
